attchmntText: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited submitted copies of the publication of advertisements regarding its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 13, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 15, 2026, in the Financial Express newspaper in both English and Gujarati. This submission is made under Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The filing was signed by Amay Vatsalya, Whole-time Director and CFO, with DIN 09330694.

attchmntText: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited announced the outcome of its Board of Directors meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This approval was based on the recommendation of the Audit Committee and included the Limited Review Report. The meeting commenced at 5:15 p.m. IST and concluded at 6:30 p.m. IST. The financial results, along with the Limited Review Reports and this outcome, will be available on the company website at https://vaxtexcotfabltd.com/. The announcement was signed by Amay Vatsalya, Whole-time Director and CFO, with DIN 09330694.

attchmntText: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has informed the Exchange regarding voting results of  Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited announces the outcome of the Postal Ballot held for the appointment of Statutory Auditor for five years from fiscal year 2026-27 to fiscal year 2030-31. The voting period ran from October 14, 2026, to November 12, 2026. The resolution was passed with the requisite majority. Total shares held were 18,37,52,220. Votes polled were 3,08,02,287, representing 16.7629 percent of outstanding shares. Votes in favor totaled 3,07,99,735, or 99.9917 percent of votes polled. Votes against were 2,552, or 0.0083 percent. The result was declared on November 13, 2026. Amay Vatsalya, Whole-time Director and CFO, signed the disclosure.

attchmntText: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited filed the Scrutinizer report regarding the outcome of the Postal Ballot on November 13, 2026. The resolution concerned the appointment of the Statutory Auditor for a period of 5 Years from F.Y. 2026-27 to F.Y. 2030-31. The e-voting period ran from October 14, 2026, to November 12, 2026. NVB & Associates conducted the scrutiny. The results show that 49 members voted in favor, representing 3,07,99,735 votes, which is 99.9917% of the total valid votes cast. Three members voted against the resolution, representing 2,552 votes, or 0.0706% of the total valid votes. There were zero invalid votes. The resolution is deemed passed based on these results.

attchmntText: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited has informed the Exchange about Issue of Warning Letter by National Stock Exchange of India Limited ( NSE ).
voiceSummary: Vaxtex Cotfab Limited disclosed that the National Stock Exchange issued a warning letter on November 5, 2026, referencing number NSE/LIST/VCL/01/2026-2027. The exchange cited non-compliance with Regulation 31A of SEBI LODR regarding the reclassification of Promoter Shareholders. The company submitted the application on July 30, 2026, but failed to disclose this submission within the required twenty-four-hour window. The disclosure was instead made on August 13, 2026, instead of by July 31, 2026. The company stated the delay was inadvertent and regretted the lapse. It confirmed compliance with all other provisions and promised timely future compliance. The managing director is Aakash Rajeshbhai Thakor with DIN 07960192.
